usedFor: Wildapricot holds members, payments and events, and Sangam CRM receives each person through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Membership Created” in Wildapricot, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new membership reaches Sangam CRM as a lead, updated if the ID, email or phone already exists.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” updates by ID, email or phone, so “New Membership Created” must pass one of them.
